description: This file contains API utility functions for managing query-related operations such as saving, listing, retrieving, deleting, toggling favorites, retrieving history, and rerunning queries within a device management frontend. It handles both real API calls and mock data for testing.

methods.name: saveQuery({ name, protocol, deviceId, parameters, isFavorite = false })
methods.description: Saves a query with given parameters; returns saved query data or mock response

methods.name: listQueries({ page = 1, pageSize = 10, favorites = false } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of saved queries, with optional filtering for favorites

methods.name: getQueryById(queryId)
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific query by its ID

methods.name: deleteQuery(queryId)
methods.description: Deletes a query identified by its ID

methods.name: toggleFavorite(queryId, isFavorite)
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a query

methods.name: getQueryHistory({ page = 1, pageSize = 10, protocol, deviceId, status, search, dateFrom, dateTo, sort } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves the history of query executions with filtering options

methods.name: rerunQuery(queryId)
methods.description: Initiates a rerun of a previous query by its ID

ctags.name: getQueryHistory
ctags.signature: ({ page = 1, pageSize = 10, protocol, deviceId, status, search, dateFrom, dateTo, sort } = {})

ctags.name: listQueries
ctags.pattern: /^export async function listQueries({ page = 1, pageSize = 10, favorites = false } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: saveQuery
ctags.pattern: /^export async function saveQuery({ name, protocol, deviceId, parameters, isFavorite = false }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ name, protocol, deviceId, parameters, isFavorite = false })
